streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: Configuration of the HLS segment format and size. Affects startup speed and quality switching.
streaming.auto_quality_mode_help: Defines what the "Auto" quality does. Explicit quality choices are not affected: "Original" stays in Direct Play if the device is compatible.
streaming.auto_quality_mode_directplay_help: In "Auto", the server sends the original file without transcoding when the device is compatible: near-zero server load. Downside: no automatic bitrate adaptation — on a slow connection, manually choose a lower quality.
streaming.auto_quality_mode_abr_help: In "Auto", the server transcodes to adaptive HLS that adjusts quality to the network bitrate in real time. Downside: every "Auto" playback uses transcoding (CPU/GPU) — reserve it for servers with hardware acceleration.
streaming.segment_duration_help: Shorter segments = faster startup but more HTTP requests. 3s is a good compromise.
streaming.auto_crop_help: Detects and removes black bars (letterbox/pillarbox). Cropping forces re-encoding: disable it on low-powered servers to play the source as-is (black bars kept) without transcoding.
streaming.init_time_help: The first segment can be shorter to speed up startup. The following ones use the normal duration.
streaming.qsv_preset_help: From 'veryfast' (fastest, lower quality) to 'veryslow' (slowest, best quality). 'faster' is the good compromise for on-the-fly transcoding. Does not apply to VAAPI or NVENC.
streaming.tonemap_algo_help: Choice of the ffmpeg filter to convert HDR to SDR. The Auto default uses tonemap_opencl (reinhard) — better dynamic range on Intel iGPUs whose fixed VPP LUT underexposes. Switch to tonemap_vaapi or vpp_qsv if the OpenCL bridge does not work on your machine (faster cold start, but potentially dark image depending on the iGPU).
streaming.gpu_device_help: Which GPU handles hardware transcoding. On a multi-GPU host, pin a specific device to keep sessions off the wrong adapter.
streaming.qsv_low_power_help: Enables -low_power 1 (VDENC, Intel Gen9+). Faster encoding but slightly lower quality. Test according to the CPU generation.
streaming.cache_purge_help: Clears all cached transcoded segments to free up disk space. Playbacks in progress will need to retranscode (brief rebuffering); restart is automatic.
streaming.cache_purge_confirm: This deletes all cached transcoded segments. Playbacks in progress will retranscode on the fly (brief rebuffering). Continue?
